verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs say Books pulls in Mercury banking data automatically and lets users link external bank accounts, cards and payroll platforms, naming Stripe, PayPal and Gusto, with transactions categorized and reconciled in real time. That covers banking, payments and payroll flowing into the ledger. Mercury itself notes that a connected system still leaves some bookkeeping decisions to people, but that concerns categorization rather than the data feeds. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed docs on how external syncs work (frequency, history import, failure handling), and a broader integration catalog beyond the few named platforms ('more integrations on the way').

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically
